description: The duplication half of the policy. The change does real work (a per-category breakdown and a dollars fallback for imported items) and, to get there, adds a local `toCents` whose body is character-for-character the body of `dollarsToCents` in src/money/cents.ts, two directories over. Neither name appears in the other file, so a reviewer that only reads the diff cannot see it; one grep for `Math.round(Math.abs` or for `Cents` finds it. The one comment in the diff explains the fallback and is not a documentation finding; the per-category loop is the logic work and must draw nothing.

evidence_trace: src/reports/summary.ts:7-8 adds `const toCents = (dollars: number): number => Math.sign(dollars) * Math.round(Math.abs(dollars) * 100);`
src/money/cents.ts:4-5 exports `dollarsToCents` with the identical body
grep for dollarsToCents finds no import in src/reports/summary.ts
finding.failure_scenario: The next reader of a cents bug has two names for one conversion and fixes the one they found first, and the two drift the first time either changes its rounding rule.
finding.model_authored_prose: `toCents` (summary.ts:7) is `dollarsToCents` from src/money/cents.ts with a new name: same sign handling, same rounding, same return type. Import the existing one instead of carrying a second copy.

prContext.description: The summary now carries a per-category total alongside the grand total. Imported line items arrive with float dollars instead of cents, so those are normalized on the way in.
